title: Guild Card awards file
description: The Guild Card's 48 awards, in the game's order. The game keeps which a hunter has as 48 bits of the save, bit n for award n. What it checks before giving each is in packages/mhfu-extract/docs/awards.md.

award.$comment: The award's name and the game's description of it are in data/strings under 'award' and 'award_description', keyed by its id.

id.description: The award's index: its bit in the save's award flags
